content:
# Composite action for post-check telemetry. Classifies phased timings,
# package-origin downloads, and compiler-cache outcomes, then emits one
# machine-readable VELNOR_CI_REPORT line plus a step-summary table.
name: Report Velnor CI outcomes
description: Emit VELNOR_CI_REPORT telemetry and a step summary from the unit log

inputs:
  job_label:
    description: Stable Actions job label included in the telemetry record
    required: true
  ci_lane:
    description: Lane label (`github` or `velnor`) for cache-outcome classification
    required: false
    default: ""
  host_warm_layers:
    description: Comma-separated Velnor host-warm cache layers
    required: false
    default: ""
  cache_rustup_primary:
    required: false
    default: ""
  cache_rustup_matched:
    required: false
    default: ""
  cache_mold_primary:
    required: false
    default: ""
  cache_mold_matched:
    required: false
    default: ""
  cache_cargo_primary:
    required: false
    default: ""
  cache_cargo_matched:
    required: false
    default: ""
  cache_mbx_hit:
    required: false
    default: ""
  cache_mbx_primary:
    required: false
    default: ""
  cache_docker_seed_primary:
    required: false
    default: ""
  cache_docker_seed_matched:
    required: false
    default: ""

runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Report phase timings and cache outcomes
      shell: bash
      env:
        VELNOR_JOB_NAME: ${{ inputs.job_label }}
        # Hosted Actions supplies this context value. Velnor supplies the
        # runner-owned VELNOR_* timing env instead; keep this name distinct so
        # an empty hosted expression cannot overwrite it.
        VELNOR_CONTEXT_RUN_STARTED_AT: ${{ github.run_started_at }}
        VELNOR_CI_LANE: ${{ inputs.ci_lane }}
        VELNOR_HOST_WARM_LAYERS: ${{ inputs.host_warm_layers }}
        VELNOR_RUN_STARTED_AT: ${{ env.VELNOR_RUN_STARTED_AT }}
        VELNOR_JOB_QUEUED_AT: ${{ env.VELNOR_JOB_QUEUED_AT }}
        VELNOR_CACHE_RUSTUP_PRIMARY: ${{ inputs.cache_rustup_primary }}
        VELNOR_CACHE_RUSTUP_MATCHED: ${{ inputs.cache_rustup_matched }}
        VELNOR_CACHE_MOLD_PRIMARY: ${{ inputs.cache_mold_primary }}
        VELNOR_CACHE_MOLD_MATCHED: ${{ inputs.cache_mold_matched }}
        VELNOR_CACHE_CARGO_PRIMARY: ${{ inputs.cache_cargo_primary }}
        VELNOR_CACHE_CARGO_MATCHED: ${{ inputs.cache_cargo_matched }}
        VELNOR_CACHE_MBX_HIT: ${{ inputs.cache_mbx_hit }}
        VELNOR_CACHE_MBX_PRIMARY: ${{ inputs.cache_mbx_primary }}
        VELNOR_CACHE_DOCKER_SEED_PRIMARY: ${{ inputs.cache_docker_seed_primary }}
        VELNOR_CACHE_DOCKER_SEED_MATCHED: ${{ inputs.cache_docker_seed_matched }}
      run: |
        set -uo pipefail
        max_telemetry_seconds=$((7 * 24 * 60 * 60))
        timing_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/velnor-ci-timing-${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-unknown}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-0}-${GITHUB_JOB:-unknown}"
        job_ended="$(date +%s)"
        log="$RUNNER_TEMP/velnor-unit-log.txt"
        log_present=false
        if [[ -s "$log" ]]; then log_present=true; fi
        read_marker() {
          local marker="$1"
          local value=""
          if [[ -r "$timing_dir/$marker" ]]; then
            IFS= read -r value < "$timing_dir/$marker" || true
          fi
          printf '%s' "$value"
        }
        valid_epoch() {
          [[ "${1:-}" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]{9}$ ]]
        }
        bounded_duration() {
          local duration="${1:-}"
          [[ "$duration" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || return 1
          [[ "${#duration}" -le 6 ]] || return 1
          (( 10#$duration <= max_telemetry_seconds ))
        }
        phase_seconds() {
          local start="${1:-}" end="${2:-}"
          if valid_epoch "$start" && valid_epoch "$end" && valid_epoch "$job_ended" \
            && (( 10#$end >= 10#$start && 10#$end <= 10#$job_ended \
              && 10#$job_ended - 10#$start <= max_telemetry_seconds )); then
            local duration=$((10#$end - 10#$start))
            if bounded_duration "$duration"; then
              echo "$duration"
              return 0
            fi
          fi
          return 1
        }
        job_started="$(read_marker JOB_STARTED)"
        job_started_usable=false
        total_source="unusable_job_start"
        total=""
        if valid_epoch "$job_started"; then
          total_candidate="$(phase_seconds "$job_started" "$job_ended" || true)"
          if [[ -n "$total_candidate" ]]; then
            total="$total_candidate"
            job_started_usable=true
            total_source="job_markers"
          fi
        fi
        runner_setup_end="$(read_marker RUNNER_SETUP_ENDED)"
        selection_end="$(read_marker SELECTION_ENDED)"
        tool_bootstrap_end="$(read_marker TOOL_BOOTSTRAP_ENDED)"
        cache_prep_end="$(read_marker CACHE_PREP_ENDED)"
        cargo_fetch_end="$(read_marker CARGO_FETCH_ENDED)"
        checks_started="$(read_marker CHECKS_STARTED)"
        checks_ended="$(read_marker CHECKS_ENDED)"
        cleanup_end="$(read_marker CLEANUP_ENDED)"
        runner_setup="$(phase_seconds "$job_started" "$runner_setup_end" || true)"
        selection_transport="$(phase_seconds "$runner_setup_end" "$selection_end" || true)"
        tool_bootstrap="$(phase_seconds "$selection_end" "$tool_bootstrap_end" || true)"
        cache_prep="$(phase_seconds "$tool_bootstrap_end" "$cache_prep_end" || true)"
        cargo_fetch="$(phase_seconds "$cache_prep_end" "$cargo_fetch_end" || true)"
        checks_wall="$(phase_seconds "$checks_started" "$checks_ended" || true)"
        cleanup="$(phase_seconds "$checks_ended" "$cleanup_end" || true)"
        queue=""
        queue_source=""
        job_name="${VELNOR_JOB_NAME:-}"
        run_started="${VELNOR_CONTEXT_RUN_STARTED_AT:-${VELNOR_RUN_STARTED_AT:-}}"
        queue_at="${VELNOR_JOB_QUEUED_AT:-}"
        rfc3339_epoch() {
          local value="${1:-}"
          [[ -n "$value" ]] || return 1
          jq -nr --arg value "$value" '
            try ($value | sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | fromdateiso8601)
            catch empty
          ' 2>/dev/null
        }
        queue_seconds_from_timestamp() {
          local timestamp="${1:-}"
          local queued_epoch=""
          local queue_candidate=""
          queued_epoch="$(rfc3339_epoch "$timestamp" || true)"
          if valid_epoch "$queued_epoch" && [[ "$job_started_usable" == true ]] \
            && (( 10#$job_started >= 10#$queued_epoch )); then
            queue_candidate=$((10#$job_started - 10#$queued_epoch))
            if bounded_duration "$queue_candidate"; then
              echo "$queue_candidate"
              return 0
            fi
          fi
          return 1
        }
        if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 && [[ "$job_started_usable" == true ]]; then
          if [[ -n "$queue_at" ]]; then
            queue_candidate="$(queue_seconds_from_timestamp "$queue_at" || true)"
            if bounded_duration "$queue_candidate"; then
              queue="$queue_candidate"
              queue_source="job_queue_time"
            fi
          fi
          if [[ -z "$queue" && -n "$run_started" ]]; then
            queue_candidate="$(queue_seconds_from_timestamp "$run_started" || true)"
            if bounded_duration "$queue_candidate"; then
              queue="$queue_candidate"
              queue_source="workflow_run_started_at"
            fi
          fi
        fi
        if [[ -z "$job_name" ]]; then
          job_name="unknown"
        fi
        classify_gha_cache() {
          local primary="${1:-}" matched="${2:-}"
          if [[ -z "$primary" && -z "$matched" ]]; then
            return 0
          fi
          if [[ -z "$matched" ]]; then
            echo cold
          elif [[ "$primary" == "$matched" ]]; then
            echo exact
          else
            echo prefix
          fi
        }
        host_warm_layer() {
          local layer="$1"
          local layers="${VELNOR_HOST_WARM_LAYERS:-}"
          [[ -n "$layers" ]] || return 1
          [[ ",$layers," == *",$layer,"* ]]
        }
        classify_mbx() {
          if host_warm_layer mbx; then
            echo host_warm
            return
          fi
          local hit="${VELNOR_CACHE_MBX_HIT:-}"
          if [[ "$hit" == "true" ]]; then
            echo exact
            return
          fi
          if [[ -s "$log" ]]; then
            if grep -qiE 'exact hit' "$log"; then
              echo exact
              return
            fi
            if grep -qiE 'warm start' "$log"; then
              echo prefix
              return
            fi
            if grep -qiE '(^|[^a-z])miss([^a-z]|$)' "$log"; then
              echo cold
              return
            fi
          fi
          if [[ "$hit" == "false" ]]; then
            echo prefix
            return
          fi
          echo cold
        }
        cache_outcome_for() {
          local layer="$1"
          local primary="${2:-}" matched="${3:-}"
          if host_warm_layer "$layer"; then
            echo host_warm
            return
          fi
          if [[ "$layer" == mbx ]]; then
            classify_mbx
            return
          fi
          classify_gha_cache "$primary" "$matched"
        }
        rustup_outcome="$(cache_outcome_for rustup "${VELNOR_CACHE_RUSTUP_PRIMARY:-}" "${VELNOR_CACHE_RUSTUP_MATCHED:-}")"
        mold_outcome="$(cache_outcome_for mold "${VELNOR_CACHE_MOLD_PRIMARY:-}" "${VELNOR_CACHE_MOLD_MATCHED:-}")"
        cargo_outcome="$(cache_outcome_for cargo "${VELNOR_CACHE_CARGO_PRIMARY:-}" "${VELNOR_CACHE_CARGO_MATCHED:-}")"
        mbx_outcome="$(cache_outcome_for mbx "" "")"
        docker_seed_outcome="$(cache_outcome_for docker_seed "${VELNOR_CACHE_DOCKER_SEED_PRIMARY:-}" "${VELNOR_CACHE_DOCKER_SEED_MATCHED:-}")"
        updating_index=0
        updating_git=0
        downloading_crates=0
        compiling_count=0
        downloaded_lines=""
        mbx_lines=""
        finished_lines=""
        if [[ -s "$log" ]]; then
          updating_index="$(grep -c 'Updating crates.io index' "$log" || true)"
          updating_git="$(grep -cE 'Updating git (repository|submodule)' "$log" || true)"
          downloading_crates="$(grep -c 'Downloading crates' "$log" || true)"
          compiling_count="$(grep -c 'Compiling ' "$log" || true)"
          downloaded_lines="$(grep -E 'Downloaded [0-9]+ crate' "$log" || true)"
          mbx_lines="$(grep -E 'mbx(\[cache\])?:' "$log" | grep -E 'hits|misses' || true)"
          finished_lines="$(grep -E 'Finished .* in ' "$log" || true)"
        fi
        positive_int() {
          local value="$1"
          [[ "$value" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || value=0
          printf '%s' "$value"
        }
        cache_outcomes_json='{}'
        if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
          cache_outcomes_json="$(jq -nc \
            --arg lane "${VELNOR_CI_LANE:-}" \
            --arg rustup "$rustup_outcome" \
            --arg mold "$mold_outcome" \
            --arg cargo "$cargo_outcome" \
            --arg mbx "$mbx_outcome" \
            --arg docker_seed "$docker_seed_outcome" \
            '{
              lane: ($lane | if length > 0 then . else null end),
              rustup: ($rustup | if length > 0 then . else null end),
              mold: ($mold | if length > 0 then . else null end),
              cargo: ($cargo | if length > 0 then . else null end),
              mbx: ($mbx | if length > 0 then . else null end),
              docker_seed: ($docker_seed | if length > 0 then . else null end)
            }' 2>/dev/null || echo '{}')"
        fi
        cold_layers=()
        for layer in rustup mold cargo mbx docker_seed; do
          outcome=""
          case "$layer" in
            rustup) outcome="$rustup_outcome" ;;
            mold) outcome="$mold_outcome" ;;
            cargo) outcome="$cargo_outcome" ;;
            mbx) outcome="$mbx_outcome" ;;
            docker_seed) outcome="$docker_seed_outcome" ;;
          esac
          if [[ "$outcome" == cold ]]; then
            cold_layers+=("$layer")
          fi
        done
        report_json="$(jq -nc \
          --arg job "$job_name" \
          --arg queue "$queue" \
          --arg queue_source "$queue_source" \
          --arg total_source "$total_source" \
          --arg runner_setup "$runner_setup" \
          --arg selection_transport "$selection_transport" \
          --arg tool_bootstrap "$tool_bootstrap" \
          --arg cache_prep "$cache_prep" \
          --arg cargo_fetch "$cargo_fetch" \
          --arg checks_wall "$checks_wall" \
          --arg cleanup "$cleanup" \
          --arg total "$total" \
          --argjson log_present "$log_present" \
          --argjson updating_index "$(positive_int "$updating_index")" \
          --argjson updating_git "$(positive_int "$updating_git")" \
          --argjson downloading_crates "$(positive_int "$downloading_crates")" \
          --argjson compiling_count "$(positive_int "$compiling_count")" \
          --argjson downloaded_lines "$(printf '%s' "$downloaded_lines" | jq -Rsc 'split("\n") | map(select(length > 0))' || true)" \
          --argjson mbx "$(printf '%s' "$mbx_lines" | jq -Rsc 'split("\n") | map(select(length > 0))' || true)" \
          --argjson finished "$(printf '%s' "$finished_lines" | jq -Rsc 'split("\n") | map(select(length > 0))' || true)" \
          --argjson cache_outcomes "$cache_outcomes_json" \
          '{
            schema_version: 1,
            job: $job,
            log_present: $log_present,
            queue_seconds: ($queue | if test("^[0-9]+$") then tonumber else null end),
            queue_source: ($queue_source | if length > 0 then . else null end),
            total_source: $total_source,
            runner_setup_seconds: ($runner_setup | if test("^[0-9]+$") then tonumber else null end),
            selection_transport_seconds: ($selection_transport | if test("^[0-9]+$") then tonumber else null end),
            tool_bootstrap_seconds: ($tool_bootstrap | if test("^[0-9]+$") then tonumber else null end),
            cache_prep_seconds: ($cache_prep | if test("^[0-9]+$") then tonumber else null end),
            cargo_fetch_seconds: ($cargo_fetch | if test("^[0-9]+$") then tonumber else null end),
            checks_wall_seconds: ($checks_wall | if test("^[0-9]+$") then tonumber else null end),
            checks_seconds: ($checks_wall | if test("^[0-9]+$") then tonumber else null end),
            cleanup_seconds: ($cleanup | if test("^[0-9]+$") then tonumber else null end),
            total_seconds: ($total | if test("^[0-9]+$") then tonumber else null end),
            cache_outcomes: $cache_outcomes,
            origin_downloads: {
              updating_crates_io_index: $updating_index,
              updating_git: $updating_git,
              downloading_crates: $downloading_crates,
              downloaded_lines: $downloaded_lines
            },
            compiler: {
              mbx_outcomes: $mbx,
              finished_segments: $finished,
              compiling_lines: $compiling_count
            }
          }' 2>/dev/null || true)"
        if [[ -z "$report_json" ]]; then
          report_json="VELNOR_CI_REPORT_FALLBACK job=$job_name"
        fi
        echo "VELNOR_CI_REPORT $report_json"
        {
          echo ""
          echo '### Phase timings and cache outcomes'
          echo ""
          echo '```json'
          echo "$report_json"
          echo '```'
          echo ""
          echo "| metric | value |"
          echo "| --- | --- |"
          echo "| lane | ${VELNOR_CI_LANE:-unknown} |"
          echo "| cache_outcomes.rustup | ${rustup_outcome:-n/a} |"
          echo "| cache_outcomes.mold | ${mold_outcome:-n/a} |"
          echo "| cache_outcomes.cargo | ${cargo_outcome:-n/a} |"
          echo "| cache_outcomes.mbx | ${mbx_outcome:-n/a} |"
          echo "| cache_outcomes.docker_seed | ${docker_seed_outcome:-n/a} |"
          echo "| queue_seconds | ${queue:-unknown} |"
          echo "| runner_setup_seconds | ${runner_setup:-unknown} |"
          echo "| selection_transport_seconds | ${selection_transport:-unknown} |"
          echo "| tool_bootstrap_seconds | ${tool_bootstrap:-unknown} |"
          echo "| cache_prep_seconds | ${cache_prep:-unknown} |"
          echo "| cargo_fetch_seconds | ${cargo_fetch:-unknown} |"
          echo "| checks_wall_seconds | ${checks_wall:-unknown} |"
          echo "| cleanup_seconds | ${cleanup:-unknown} |"
          echo "| total_seconds | ${total:-unknown} |"
          echo "| updating_crates_io_index | $updating_index |"
          echo "| updating_git | $updating_git |"
          echo "| downloading_crates | $downloading_crates |"
          echo "| compiling_lines | $compiling_count |"
        } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY" 2>/dev/null || true
        if ((${#cold_layers[@]} > 0)); then
          echo "::warning::Cold cache layer(s): ${cold_layers[*]} (lane=${VELNOR_CI_LANE:-unknown})"
        fi
        exit 0
